card.statement:
The algebra $U_{\mathbb A}$
inherits the standard triangular decomposition of $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak g})$.
In particular,
any element $u $ of $U_{\mathbb A}$ can be written as an $\mathbb A$-linear combination of
monomials of the form $u^-u^0u^+$ where $u^{\pm} \in U_{\mathbb A}^{\pm}$
and $u^0 \in U_{\mathbb A}^0$.
card.label: Corollary 8

paper.title: An imaginary PBW basis for quantum affine algebras of type 1
paper.abstract: Let $\hat{\mathfrak g}$ be an affine Lie algebra of type 1. We give a PBW basis for the quantum affine algebra $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak g})$ with respect to the triangular decomposition of $\hat{\mathfrak g}$ associated with the imaginary positive root system.
